summary_md:
# 128. Oxfilén dissas och falukorven hissas

**Feed**: borssurr  
**Published**: 2026-10-23  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The hosts say the Stockholm market is rewarding beaten-down, heavily shorted 'dog' stocks such as AFRY, Nelly, Lyko, Bone Support, Dometic, Hemnet and Profoto on their reports. Meanwhile, the well-loved quality names ('oxfilén') such as Sandvik, SEB, Swedbank and Handelsbanken are falling despite strong results, amid AI-capex anxiety, $112 oil and French bond stress (French 10-year OAT yield above 5%, unrest hurting Carrefour). Other themes are Thule's chairman being pushed out by institutional owners, a possible take-private of Verisure, property stocks possibly bottoming on insider buying, CoreWeave as a contrarian AI buy (cited Handelsbanken strategist), and an 'ESG/woke trade' comeback idea including Tomra, Vestas, Ørsted and Novo Nordisk.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 CRWV — CoreWeave | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Handelsbanken FX strategist Michelle Gübel: chip rental has done much better than the stock and the order book is strong, so it looks like a buying opportunity.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst view, not the hosts' own. The market worries about concentration and credit, but the business model holds: long binding contracts and a front-loaded order book, so the revenue is there and the remaining issue is funding the buildout. Hosts call it 'a trade for those who dare'. High debt and the Gartner warning that 80% of neoclouds may fail add risk.

#### Sell Triggers

- credit spreads widen further / financing fails
- customer concentration losses
- order book contract cancellations

> *"Det här menar han talar för att det är ett köpläge i misshandlade Coreweave"*

---

### 🟠 TOM — Tomra | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Host says Tomra will turn; a UK order worth €30m is 'a step in the right direction' and lowers the risk of missing expectations.

#### Reasoning

Host opinion. Tomra has been a beaten-down ESG name. A new UK order strengthens its market position there and reduces estimate risk. It also fits the contrarian 'woke trade comeback' idea now that anti-ESG sentiment may have peaked. Conviction is low.

#### Sell Triggers

- further order weakness
- missed expectations in next report

> *"Det kommer vända för Tomra."*

---

### 🟠 NOVO-B — Novo Nordisk | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 35%

ESG darling, down 20% this year; 'maybe a woke stock to buy the dip in, what do I know'.

#### Reasoning

A speculative host idea from an AI-generated woke basket. It has strong ESG ratings but poor shareholder returns lately. A dip-buy only if the ESG trade comes back. The host expresses no real conviction.

#### Sell Triggers

- continued earnings downgrades
- ESG trade does not rebound

> *"Men kanske en Woke-aktie att köpa dippen i, vad vet jag."*

---

### 🟠 BALD-B — Balder | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Property stocks are down 20%+ in a year while the market is up 10%; insiders and Alecta are buying; rate fears seen as largely priced in.

#### Reasoning

Cited Börslunch guests: real estate looks cheap relative to the market. Industry profiles (Huvudstaden, Prisma), Alecta (Balder) and company buybacks suggest insiders see a bottom. Rising rates remain the counter-risk.

#### Sell Triggers

- further rise in interest rates
- insider buying reverses

> *"Alecta har gått in i Balder och bolagen själva gör återköp, så insiders går in."*

---

### 🟠 THULE — Thule | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Major institutions (~28% of capital) ousted the chairman the day before the report; the report was OK and the CEO calm, but hosts suspect something dramatic.

#### Reasoning

Host opinion. The governance shake-up mid-term is unusual and suggests owners are unhappy, even though the report was fine. Thule was once over-loved, and its products are so durable that they limit repeat sales. Watch for clarity on the board and strategy.

#### Sell Triggers

- CEO departure
- strategy overhaul signalling deeper problems
- weak demand in next report

> *"Det måste ju vara någonting ganska dramatiskt som ligger bakom."*

---

### 🟠 VSURE — Verisure | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

FT: PE owners are considering a buyout after a disappointing listing; the stock is rising sharply.

#### Reasoning

A possible take-private gives an event-driven upside, but the hosts mainly lament it rather than recommend the stock.

#### Sell Triggers

- buyout talks collapse

> *"Nu verkar riskkapitalisterna som äger Verisure vara trötta på detta och fundera på ett utköp."*

---
